description: Look up one ranked seller by its domain: its category and rank; its spend in USD, buyers and paid calls over the last 30 days; median price per call; chains; its rank, spend and buyers at the end of each recent week; a link to its site and its Agent Charts page. Use it to check a tool you already have in mind; use best_tools to compare a whole category. A domain that isn't ranked returns an error. Read-only and free, no sign-in.

domain.description: The seller's domain in lowercase, without https:// or a path, such as exa.ai

name: seller
